programs.title: Our Dead Husband

programs.title: How She Caught A Killer
programs.desc: The Route 40 Killer targets sex workers with an unknown motive. Detective Linda Murphy goes undercover and gets entangled in a chilling cat-and-mouse game, reminiscent of The Silence of the Lambs.

programs.title: Enlighten Your Life
programs.desc: As people spend more time at home due to the pandemic, interest in home decor has surged. We'll be showcasing two distinct styles: a Hanok that embodies Eastern beauty, and a Western-style house.

programs.title: Airline Wars
programs.desc: Airline drama is at an all-time high and we've got the viral videos to prove it. See what happens when people are caught on camera acting up and acting out. We're headed for the not-so-friendly skies.

programs.title: Airline Wars
programs.desc: Utter chaos erupts when a man goes on the attack while waiting in the security line. A pilot is arrested for attempting to operate an aircraft while under the influence.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Holidays
programs.desc: What is red, white and green all over? It's Rachael Ray's lasagne! Rachael shows how to make delicious lasagne by layering sheets of pasta with cime di rapa, ricotta and a ragu sauce.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Holidays
programs.sub_title: Cheese Fondue With Vegetables, Sausage And Beef Tips
programs.desc: Impress your holiday guests with a classic cheesy fondue party! Rachael shows how to make her version of an easy and decadent 'Fundue' that is sure to bring everyone around to celebrate the holidays.

programs.title: Masterchef Australia
programs.desc: With Curtis Stone's help, our three Semi-Finalists serve a three-course menu for 20 diners and judges, competing for a place in the Grand Finale.

programs.desc: In honour of Rachael's rock-star friends, she's making hella mexa suiza burgers, or hamburgers and fries cooked with Mexican spices and topped with Swiss and Mexican soft cheese.

programs.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
programs.desc: Rachael shows how to make bacalao con pomodoro, a dish inspired by an amazing meal she shared with husband John during a special trip to Elba, a Mediterranean island in Tuscany.

programs.title: Casting 1147Km
programs.desc: Six charismatic rookie actors gather under one roof for a groundbreaking residency audition. Age, experience and style all differ, but they share one goal: to become the male lead of a romantic drama.

programs.title: Global Soul Kitchen
